sbar.situation: 68-year-old female status-post urgent 3-vessel CABG on 10/20, successfully extubated yesterday, weaned off inotropes, now clinically ready for transfer to 4-West Step-Down Telemetry.
sbar.background: Past medical history includes CAD, hypertension, hyperlipidemia, and Type 2 diabetes. Underwent LIMA to LAD, SVG to OM1 and RCA. Chest tubes removed POD 3, epicardial pacing wires coiled and secured.
sbar.assessment: Vitals stable. Alert and oriented x4. NSR with occasional benign PVCs on telemetry. Lungs clear bilaterally on 2L NC. Sternal incision clean, sternum mechanically stable with sternal guard vest in place. Pain controlled at 2/10.
sbar.recommendation: Continuous cardiac telemetry monitoring on 4-West. Keep SBP between 100-130 mmHg. Daily standing weight, strict I&O. PT ambulation with sternal precautions twice daily. Follow up repeat morning troponin and potassium at 06:00.

sbar.situation: 52-year-old male with traumatic brain injury and subarachnoid hemorrhage following cycling accident on 10/18, transfer to Inpatient Neuro Rehab for intensive physical, occupational, and cognitive therapies.
sbar.background: Non-surgical conservative management of SAH. Clamped EVD pulled yesterday. No seizures. Independent prior to accident.
sbar.assessment: GCS 14. Mild expressive dysphasia. Cranial nerves intact. Motor strength 5/5 on right, 4+/5 on left. Ambulates 50 feet with steadying assist of 1. High fall risk due to impulsivity.
sbar.recommendation: Inpatient rehab 3 hrs daily. Bed alarm active at all times. Nimodipine through Day 21 (11/08). Speech therapy pureed diet protocol.

sbar.situation: 34-year-old G2P1 at 33w4d with severe preeclampsia, intractable severe-range blood pressures up to 164/108, transferring urgently to L&D OR 3 for urgent evaluation and likely cesarean delivery.
sbar.background: Antepartum admission 3 days ago for gestational hypertension. Platelets dropping (currently 114k), AST/ALT elevated at 88/92. Received 2 doses Betamethasone for fetal lung maturity.
sbar.assessment: Maternal BP 158/104. Fetal heart rate baseline 145 with moderate variability. Deep tendon reflexes +3 with 1 beat clonus. Headache mild, no visual disturbances reported right now.
sbar.recommendation: Immediate transport to L&D OR 3. Maintain Magnesium infusion 2g/hr with Calcium Gluconate accompanying. NICU resuscitation team notified and standing by. Anesthesia consultation ready at arrival.
sbar.receivingNurse: Megan St. Clair, BSN, RN, CNOR (Badge #7702)

sbar.situation: 74-year-old male recovering from severe community-acquired right lower lobe pneumonia and COPD flare, transferring via BLS ambulance to Pinecrest Post-Acute Care for rehabilitation.
sbar.background: History of severe COPD on home Spiriva, hypertension, osteoarthritis. Admitted on 10/17 with fever, productive cough, and hypoxia. Completed 5-day IV Rocephin and Azithromycin.
sbar.assessment: Vitals stable. Alert and oriented x3. Bilateral expiratory wheezes, improved from admission. SpO2 96% on room air at rest, drops to 92% with 100ft ambulation. Independent with rolling walker.
sbar.recommendation: Continue PT/OT rehabilitation 5x weekly. Sub-acute stay anticipated 14-21 days. Follow up with outpatient pulmonologist in 3 weeks. Full DNR/DNI documented on POLST.

sbar.situation: 41-year-old female with sudden acute substernal crushing chest pain radiating to jaw and left arm starting at 06:40 AM today, ECG confirms acute anterior STEMI with 4mm ST elevations.
sbar.background: No significant past medical history. Smoker 1 pack/day. Family history of premature coronary artery disease in father at age 44.
sbar.assessment: BP 106/68, HR 98 sinus tach, SpO2 95% on room air. Diaphoretic, pale, distress 8/10. Radial pulses intact bilaterally.
sbar.recommendation: Immediate primary percutaneous coronary intervention (PCI). Right radial artery preferred approach. Emergency defibrillator attached throughout transition.
